Reference / locale/system

locale/system#

The locales a user prefers, from the operating system and the environment.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let preferred = PreferredLocales(Environment());
LookedUpLocale(requested: …, available: supported, fallback: Locale("en"));

Description#

The locales a user prefers, from the operating system and the environment.

LANGUAGE, then LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES and LANG are read; on platforms with a language setting (macOS, Windows) that comes first.
